status_note: experimental group G; opt-in, costed, isolated from default policy

output.numerator: distinct exact package, version-label, and artifact identities with an observed digest change
output.denominator: not a rate; no population denominator is implied

denominator_rule: counts exact identities only; a no-change result requires complete declared identity scope and observation history, and only identities with at least two distinct capture times are comparable
confounders: a digest change can be an intentional rebuild or republishing and does not establish compromise
artifact identity and timestamp precision come from the supplied capture and may be incomplete
incomplete source scope or history prevents a no-change conclusion
limits: emits only exact package, version-label, artifact digest changes and same-time conflicts
never infers intent, cause, maliciousness, or artifact safety
opt-in only and excluded from default policy; maximum 256 observations per input
